# Project guidelines

## GitHub sync

- After each coding task, run the narrowest relevant checks. When they pass, commit the files changed for that task and push the commit to the current branch on `origin`.
- Include only task-related files. Do not commit pre-existing staged or untracked files, local data, credentials, generated files, or machine-specific configuration unless the user explicitly requests it.
- If validation or pushing fails, report the blocker clearly and leave the changes uncommitted rather than claiming they were synced.
